formulation.segment_constraint_note: The formal KKT system uses the five interior samples per segment returned by Constraints.segment_nfz_constraint. FeasibilityChecker additionally uses the exact projection of each obstacle center onto every full segment; that exact continuous segment condition is reported separately and is not silently substituted into the formal KKT vector.
